01 WHO I AM

LEARNING OUT LOUD

I’m interested in the space where people and technology meet.

I’m a first-year CSE student specialising in AI & ML at Malla Reddy Engineering College for Women. I enjoy building interfaces, learning how AI systems work, and making complicated ideas feel easier to approach.

My projects often begin with a simple question: could this help someone in a real moment? I’m learning by making, testing, and improving one step at a time.

Safe Space

A mental wellbeing companion concept for check-ins, journaling, calming exercises, and finding trusted support. Designed around small, supportive moments instead of pressure.

Product thinkingUI / UXWeb & mobile
Explore the idea ＋

The experience brings everyday wellbeing tools together: a simple mood check-in, a private journal, breathing and grounding activities, and a clear route to human support when it’s needed.

My focus: shaping the interface and making each action feel calm, understandable, and optional.

NEXT
STEPAN AI STUDY COMPANION02
AI · LEARNING COMPANION02 / 03

NextStep

An AI agent idea connected to Safe Space: helping a person choose a manageable next action, understand why it may help, and move forward at their own pace.

AI agentsPrompt designHuman-centred AI
Explore the idea ＋

NextStep is designed to offer practical suggestions while keeping the person in control. The larger project question is how an AI companion can be useful without pretending to replace professional or personal support.

My focus: turning the assistant idea into a clear, approachable product experience.

RAIN
SAFENOTICE EARLY · RESPOND TOGETHER03
CLIMATE · SAFER CITIES03 / 03

Rain Safe

A flood-awareness concept that follows a simple path: detect water levels, understand changing conditions, estimate local risk, and help people respond sooner.

Smart citiesRisk communicationMapping
Explore the idea ＋

The concept brings local alerts, safer-route information, and emergency guidance into one place. Its core principle is to make risk information specific and understandable, without presenting uncertain predictions as facts.

My focus: connecting sensor signals and local context to actions people can understand.
